import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,sys,json
p=Path.cwd();r=subprocess.run(['pdftotext','-layout',str(p/'sources/split.pdf'),'-'],capture_output=True,text=True);assert r.returncode==0
w=lambda n,s:subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(p/'write_lane.py'),n],input=s,text=True,capture_output=True)
assert w('sources/split.txt',r.stdout).returncode==0
s=r.stdout
for a,b in [(s.find('6 The split'),s.find('6 The split')+18000),(s.rfind('Conjecture 13.5')-1500,s.rfind('Conjecture 13.5')+6500)]:
 print(s[a:b])
print('HEAD',s[:3000]);print('SECTIONS',[(x,s.find(x)) for x in ['split decomposition','Assumption 8.1','Conjecture 13.','Definition 6.']])
plan={'url':'https://arxiv.org/pdf/math/0506155','routes':['379053','379055'],'destination':'sources/nordh.pdf','source_identity':'Gustav Nordh perfect Skolem sets original 2005 manuscript','purpose':'Read exact extremal set and displacement permutation definitions and proofs'}
assert w('plans/nordh.json',json.dumps(plan)).returncode==0
r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(p/'source_get_guard.py'),str(p/'plans/nordh.json')],capture_output=True,text=True);print(r.stdout,r.stderr);sys.exit(r.returncode)
